name_reason: Follows convention data_fd2_<domain>_<descriptor>: domain=chapter, descriptor=ch08_end_scene_char_pos_y_table. 'ch08' is a valid chapter domain ID (chapters 01-30), must be preserved, not an address residue. 'pos_y' reflects the Y-coordinate semantics; 'table' reflects the array datatype. No Ghidra address residue (0x52109 absent from name). Name accurately reflects both use and data type.
purpose: Chapter 8 end-scene character placement: per-character battle-tile Y coordinate for the 10 characters staged in the chapter-8 recruit cutscene (recruit char #5, 騎士洛娜).
logic_summary: Second of two parallel 10-byte tables (X @ 0x520FF, Y @ 0x52109); sprite facing is an inline fixed value 2 in the caller (no facing table). Read-only const in .object2. Single reader fd2_chapter_08_end @ 0x234BB block-copies all 10 bytes flat onto an on-stack placement block (MOV ESI,0x52109; MOV EDI,ESP; MOVSD/MOVSD/MOVSW = 4+4+2 = 10 bytes), consumed one byte at a time (local_20[0]..abStack_18[1], no struct stride / wider access / sign extension), then passed as the Y-position argument to fd2_setup_chars_and_camera_for_intro @ 0x233C6.
element_semantics: Per-character battle-tile Y coordinate (small tile coords 18..20), one entry per staged character; indexed positionally alongside the parallel X table. Values: {20,20,20,19,19,18,19,18,19,18}.
